1.3.1.v: The words beginning with भू 'to become' and denoting action, are called धातु or verbal roots.
1.3.1.e: The words भू and others, when used to denote an action, are called 'धातु'.
1.3.1.sa: 'भू' इत्यादयः शब्दाः क्रियावाचिनि अर्थे धातुसंज्ञकाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.1.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.2.v: The nasalised vowels are इत् in उपदेश or original enunciation.
1.3.2.e: An अनुनासिक स्वर present in an उपदेश is called 'इत्'.
1.3.2.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.3.v: In उपदेश , the final consonant of roots etc. is इत्।
1.3.3.e: The ending हल् letter of  an उपदेश is called 'इत्'.
1.3.3.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.4.v: The final dental consonants and the final स् and म् are not इत् , in affixes called विभक्ति or inflective affixes.
1.3.4.e: The letters - त्, थ्, द्, ध्, न्, स्, म् - occurring in the औपदेशिक form of a विभक्ति are not called 'इत्' ।
1.3.4.sa: विभक्तिसंज्ञकप्रत्ययस्य औपदेशिकस्वरूपे विद्यमानाः - (1) तवर्गीयवर्णाः, (2) सकारः (3) मकारः - एते इत्संज्ञकाः न भवन्ति ।
1.3.4.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.5.v: The initial ञि , टु , डु are इत्।
1.3.5.e: The groups ञि, टु and डु occurring at the beginning of an उपदेश are called 'इत्'.
1.3.5.sa: उपदेशस्य आदौ विद्यमानाः 'ञि', 'टु'  तथा 'डु' एते वर्णसमुदायाः इत्संज्ञकाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.5.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.6.v: The initial ष् of an affix is indicatory.
1.3.6.e: The letter ष् at the beginning of the औपदेशिक form of a प्रत्यय is called 'इत्' ।
1.3.6.sa: प्रत्ययस्य औपदेशिकस्वरूपस्य आदिस्थः षकारः इत्संज्ञकः भवति ।
1.3.6.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.7.v: The initial palatals and linguals of an affix are indicatory.
1.3.7.e: The letters - च्, छ्, ज्, झ्, ञ्, ट्, ठ्, ड्, ढ्, ण् -  at the beginning of the औपदेशिक form of a प्रत्यय are called इत् ।
1.3.7.sa: प्रत्ययस्य औपदेशिकस्वरूपस्य आदौ विद्यमानः चवर्गीयवर्णः टवर्गीयवर्णः च इत्संज्ञकः भवति ।
1.3.7.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.8.v: The initial ल् and श् and the gutturals of all affixes, except , तद्धित are indicatory.
1.3.8.e: The letters ल्, श्, क्, ख्, ग्, घ्, ङ्  at the beginning of the औपदेशिक form of a non-तद्धित प्रत्यय are called इत् ।
1.3.8.sa: तद्धितभिन्नप्रत्ययस्य औपदेशिकस्वरूपस्य आदौ विद्यमानः लकारः, शकारः, कवर्गीयवर्णः च  इत्संज्ञकः भवति ।
1.3.8.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.9.v: Of this, (namely of that which has been called इत् ), there is elision.
1.3.9.e: The इत् letter is elided during the प्रक्रिया.
1.3.9.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.10.v: When a rule involves the case of equal numbers of substitutes and of things for which these are to be substituted, their mutual correspondence or assignment of each to each, is according to the order of enumeration.
1.3.10.e: When a certain relation is given between two groups having same number of elements, then the relation is considered to exist only between the correspondingly positioned members of the two groups.
1.3.10.sa: यत्र द्वयोः गणयोः मध्ये कस्यचन सम्बन्धस्य विधानम् क्रियते तत्र तयोः सङ्ख्या समाना अस्ति चेत् सः सम्बन्धः तयोः सदस्येषु यथासङ्ख्यम्  विधीयते ।
1.3.10.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.11.v: In these aphorisms, when a word is marked with a स्वरित accent, by that an अधिकार or a governing rule is to be understood.
1.3.11.e: In this सूत्रपाठ, a स्वरित स्वर is used to denote अनुवृत्तिs.
1.3.11.sa: अस्मिन् सूत्रपाठे अनुवृत्तेः निर्देशः स्वरितस्वरेण कृतः अस्ति ।
1.3.11.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.12.v: After a root which has an indicatory अनुदात्त vowel (अनुदात्तेत्) or an indicatory ङ् (ङित्), the affixes are those of the आत्मनेपद।
1.3.12.e: A verb that contains (a) इत्संज्ञक ङकारः, or (b) an इत्संज्ञक अनुदात्त स्वर gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
1.3.12.sa: यस्मिन् धातौ (1) ङकारः , उत (2) अनुदात्तः स्वरः - इत्संज्ञकः अस्ति, तस्मात्   आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति  ।
1.3.12.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.13.v: An आत्मनेपद affix is the substitute of the affix ल [[3.4.69]] when it denotes the action of the verb or the object of the verb.
1.3.13.e: A verb gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद in the भावे and the कर्मणि प्रयोग.
1.3.13.sa: भावे प्रयोगे,  कर्मणि प्रयोगे च धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.13.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.14.v: In denoting the agent, when reciprocity of action is to be expressed, the affixes of the आत्मनेपद are employed.
1.3.14.e: A verb gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, even in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, in the context of व्यतिहार (exchange of actions).
1.3.14.sa: क्रियायाः व्यतिहारे कर्तरि प्रयोगे अपि धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः विधीयन्ते ।
1.3.14.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.15.v: After verbs having the sense of 'motion', or 'injury', when expressing interchange of action, the आत्मनेपद affixes are used.
1.3.15.e: The verbs indicating the action of - (a) movement,  or (2) violence - do not get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, in the context of व्यतिहार (exchange of actions).
1.3.15.sa: (1) गत्यर्थकेभ्यः धातुभ्यः , (2) हिंसार्थकेभ्यः धातुभ्यः - क्रियायाः व्यतिहारे, कर्तरि प्रयोगे आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः न भवन्ति ।
1.3.15.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.16.v: And after the verbs which take the words इतरेतर 'each other' and अन्योन्य 'one another', as उपपद (or dependant qualifying words), the affixes of आत्मनेपद are not used, though reciprocity of action be denoted.
1.3.16.e: A verb does not get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद  in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, in the context of व्यतिहार (exchange of actions) when either of the words 'इतरेतर' or 'अन्योन्य' is used to describe the situation.
1.3.16.sa:
'इतरेतर' उत 'अन्योन्य' इत्यस्य उपस्थितौ,
क्रियायाः व्यतिहारे कर्तरि प्रयोगे,  धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः न विधीयन्ते ।
1.3.16.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.17.v: After the verb विश् 'to enter', when preceded by the preposition नि, the आत्मनेपद affixes are employed
1.3.17.e: When the उपसर्ग 'नि' is attached to the verb 'विश्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
1.3.17.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.18.v: After the verb क्री 'to purchase', when preceded by परि , वि or अव , the आत्मनेपद affix is employed, even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.
1.3.18.e: When any of the उपसर्गs - परि, वि, अव - is attached to the verb 'क्री', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
1.3.18.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.19.v: After the verb जि 'to conquer', preceded by वि or परा , the आत्मनेपद affix is employed.
1.3.19.e: When any of the उपसर्गs -  वि or  परा - is attached to the verb 'जि', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
1.3.19.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.20.v: After the verb दा 'to give', preceded by अङ् , and when not meaning 'to open the mouth', the आत्मनेपद affix is used, even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.
1.3.20.e: When the उपसर्ग आङ् is attached to the verb 'दा'; it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided that the  meaning is something other than 'opening the mouth'.
1.3.20.sa: 'मुखस्य उद्घाटनम्' एतमर्थम् वर्जयित्वा अन्येषु अर्थेषु 'आङ्' उपसर्गात्  'दा' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.20.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.21.v: After the verb क्रीड 'to play', preceded by अनु , सम् , or परि as well as आङ्, the आत्मनेपद affix is used.
1.3.21.e: When any of the उपसर्गs - आङ् , अनु, सम or परि - is attached to the verb 'क्रीड्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
1.3.21.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.22.v: After the verb स्था 'to stand', preceded by सम् , अव , प्र , वि , the आत्मनेपद affix is used.
1.3.22.e: When any of the उपसर्गs - सम् , अव, प्र, वि - is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
1.3.22.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.23.v: After the verb स्था 'when meaning to indicate one's intentions to another', or 'to make an award as an arbitrator', the आत्मनेपद affix is employed.
1.3.23.e: The verb स्था gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद when used in the meaning of - (a) Clearing explaining own opinion, and (b) Putting and end to a question / debate.
1.3.23.sa: प्रकाशनम् (स्पष्टरूपेण स्वमतप्रदर्शनम्) तथा स्थेयाख्या (विवादे निर्णयप्रदर्शनम्) - एतयोः अर्थयोः प्रयुक्तात् 'स्था' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.23.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.24.v: After the verb स्था 'to stand', preceded by उत् , when not meaning 'to get up or rise', as from a seat; the आत्मनेपद affix is used.
1.3.24.e: When the उपसर्ग 'उत्' is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided that the meaning is not 'moving upwards / standing up'.
1.3.24.sa: उत्थानक्रियां वर्जयित्वा अन्यत्र 'उत्' उपसर्गात् 'स्था' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.24.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.25.v: After the verb स्था 'to stand', preceded by उप , when meaning 'to adore', the आत्मनेपद affix is used.
1.3.25.e: When the उपसर्ग 'उप' is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided the meaning is 'to approach using the मन्त्रs'.
1.3.25.sa: 'मन्त्रैः निकटगमनम्' अस्मिन् अर्थे  'उप' उपसर्गात् 'स्था' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.25.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.26.v: After the verb स्था 'to stand', preceded by उप , when meaning 'to adore', the आत्मनेपद affix is used.
1.3.26.e: When the उपसर्ग 'उप' is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verb is used in an अकर्मक sense.
1.3.26.sa: अकर्मकेषु प्रयोगेषु  'उप' उपसर्गात् 'स्था' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.26.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.27.v: After the word तप 'to shine', when used intransitively and preceded by उत् or वि the आत्मनेपद affix is used.
1.3.27.e: When either of the उपसर्गs  - 'उत्', 'वि' - is attached to the verb 'तप्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of 'आत्मनेपद' ; provided that the verb is used in an अकर्मक sense.
1.3.27.sa: अकर्मकप्रयोगेषु 'उत्' / 'वि' उपसर्गात् 'तप्' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.27.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.28.v: After the verb यम् 'to stop' and हन् 'to injure', when used intransitively and preceded by अन् , the आत्मनेपद affix is used.
1.3.28.e: When the उपसर्ग 'आङ्' is attached to verbs यम् /  हन् , they get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verbs are used in an अकर्मक sense.
1.3.28.sa: अकर्मकप्रयोगेषु 'आङ्' उपसर्गात् यम्, हन् धातुभ्यामात्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.28.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.29.v: After the verbs गम् 'to go', ऋच्छ् 'to become hard', प्रच्छ् 'to ask', स्वर् 'to find fault', ऋ 'to go', श्रु 'to hear' and विद् 'to know', when used intransitively and preceded by सम् , the आत्मनेपद affix is used.
1.3.29.e: When the उपसर्ग 'सम्' is attached to any of the verbs -  गम्,  ऋच्छ्, प्रच्छ्, स्वर्, ऋ, श्रु, विद् - they get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verbs are used in an अकर्मक sense.
1.3.29.sa: अकर्मकप्रयोगेषु 'सम्' उपसर्गात्  -  गम्,  ऋच्छ्, प्रच्छ्, स्वर्, ऋ, श्रु, विद् - एतेभ्यः धातुभ्यः  आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.29.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.30.v: After the verbs ह्वे 'to call', preceded by नि , सम् , उप and वि , the आत्मनेपद is used, even, when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.
1.3.30.e: When any of the उपसर्गs - नि, सम्, वि - is attached to the verb 'ह्वे', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
1.3.30.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.31.v: After the verbs ह्वे 'to call', when meaning 'to challenge' and preceded by अङ् , the आत्मनेपद is used, even, when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.
1.3.31.e: When the उपसर्ग 'आङ्' is attached to the verb 'ह्वे', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of 'आत्मनेपद', provided the meaning is 'to complete / to wish to defeat'.
1.3.31.sa: 'स्पर्धा / सङ्घर्षः / पराभवस्य इच्छा' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'आङ्' उपसर्गात् 'ह्वे' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.31.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.32.v: After the verb कृ when meaning 'to divulge', 'to revile', 'to serve', 'to use violence', 'to cause change', 'to recite' and 'to do an act tending to effect a desired purpose', the आत्मनेपद is used, even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.
1.3.32.e:
The verb कृ gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, when used in the meanings of  - 
(1) गन्धनम् - To backbite, 
(2) अवक्षेपणम् - To defame, 
(3) सेवन् -  To serve or help out 
(4) साहसिक्यम् - To force someone to do something against their wish, To rape
(5) प्रतियत्न -To make someone change their character, 
(6) प्रकथनम् - To narrate, 
and
(7) उपयोग - To bring in practice, to use.
1.3.32.sa: गन्धनम्  (अनुपस्थितौ अपशब्दप्रयोगः), अवक्षेपणम् (निन्दा), सेवनम्  (सेवा), साहसिक्यम्  (बलात्कारः), प्रतियत्नम्  (गुणपरिवर्तनम्), प्रकथनम्  (कथनम्), उपयोग (प्रयोगः)  - एतेषु अर्थेषु कृ-धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.32.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.33.v: After the verb कृ preceded by अधि , when the sense is that of 'overcoming or defeat', the आत्मनेपद is used, even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.
1.3.33.e: When the उपसर्ग 'अधि' is attached to the verb 'कृ', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the meaning is 'to forgive / to obtain victory'.
1.3.33.sa: 'प्रसहनम्' (क्षमादानम् , विजयप्राप्तिः) एतस्मिन् अर्थे 'अधि' उपसर्गात् 'कृ' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.33.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.34.v: After the verb कृ preceded by वि , even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent, and when the sense is that of 'making sound' (literally having 'sound' for its object), the आत्मनेपद affix is used.
1.3.34.e: When the उपसर्ग 'वि' is attached to the verb 'कृ', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided the meaning is 'to make sound / to pronounce'.
1.3.34.sa: 'शब्दम् करोति / उच्चारयति' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'वि' उपसर्गात् 'कृ' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.34.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.35.v: After the verb कृ preceded by वि , when used intransitively, the आत्मनेपद is used.
1.3.35.e: When the उपसर्ग 'वि' is attached to the verb 'कृ', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verb is used in an अकर्मक sense.
1.3.35.sa: अकर्मकप्रयोगेषु 'वि' उपसर्गात् परस्य 'कृ' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.35.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.36.v: After the verb नी 'to lead', when used in the sense of 'to guide so as to render the person guided worthy', 'to lift up', 'make one a spiritual guide', 'to determine the true sense', 'to employ on wages', 'to pay debt' and 'to give as in charity', even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent, the आत्मनेपद is used.
1.3.36.e: The verb नी  gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद  ; when used in the meaning of - (1) सम्मानन, To respect in an appropriate way (2) उत्सञ्जन, To lift up, to toss (3) आचार्यकरण, To convert someone into a teacher (by imparting proper knowledge to them) (4) ज्ञान, To decide, fix upon (5) भृतिः, Employ someone by giving money (6) निगणन, To pay off, to give loan ;  and (7) व्यय, To spend.
1.3.36.sa: सम्माननम्, उत्सञ्जनम् , आचार्यकरणम्, ज्ञान, भृतिः, विगणनम् , व्ययः - एतेषु अर्थेषु 'नी' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.36.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.37.v: After the verb नी , when it governs an incorporeal object in the agent, as its object, the आत्मनेपद is used.
1.3.37.e: The verb 'नी' when used in the कर्तरि  सकर्मकप्रयोग gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided that the कर्मपद does not represent either the body or a part of the body of an animal.
1.3.37.sa: कर्तरि सकर्मकप्रयोगे ; यत्र शरीरमुत शरीरावयवः कर्मरूपेण न विधीयेते; तत्र 'नी' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।

1.3.38.v: After the verb क्रम् 'to move', when used in the senses of 'continuity', 'energy' and 'development', the आत्मनेपद is used.
1.3.38.e: The verb 'क्रम्' gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, when it is used in the meaning of - (1) वृत्तिः , To progress without getting stuck  , (2) सर्गः, enthusiasm, (3) तायनः, expansion, elaboration.
1.3.38.sa: (1) वृत्तिः (निरन्तरता)  , (2) सर्गः ( उत्साहः), (3) तायनः (विस्तारः) - एतेषु अर्थेषु 'क्रम्' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।

1.3.39.v: After the verb क्रम् , preceded by उप and पर , when used in the senses of 'continuity', 'energy' and 'development', the आत्मनेपद is used.
1.3.39.e: When the verb 'क्रम्' comes with an उपसर्ग, it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद only in the meaning of - (1) वृत्तिः , To progress without getting stuck  , (2) सर्गः, enthusiasm, (3) तायनः, expansion, elaboration.
1.3.39.sa: उपसर्गपूर्वकात् 'क्रम्' धातोः  - (1) वृत्तिः (निरन्तरता)  , (2) सर्गः ( उत्साहः), (3) तायनः (विस्तारः) - एतेषु अर्थेषु एव आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।

1.3.40.v: After the verb क्रम् , preceded by an अङ् , the आत्मनेपद is used,when in the sense of 'the rising of a luminary'.
1.3.40.e: When the उपसर्ग 'आङ्' is attached to the verb 'क्रम्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided the meaning is 'to rise, to travel upwards'.
1.3.40.sa: 'आङ्' उपसर्गात्  'क्रम्' धातोः 'उद्गमनम्' अस्मिन् अर्थे आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।

1.3.41.v: After the verb क्रम् preceded by वि , the आत्मनेपद is used, when in the sense of 'placing of foot-steps'.
1.3.41.e: When the उपसर्ग 'वि' is attached to the verb 'क्रम्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided the meaning is 'to roam around with feet'.
1.3.41.sa: 'वि' उपसर्गात्  'क्रम्' धातोः 'पादैः विहरणम्' अस्मिन् अर्थे आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।

1.3.42.v: After the verb क्रम् preceded by वि , the आत्मनेपद is used when it is preceded by प्र and उप , both conveying the same sense; viz. that of 'beginning an action'.
1.3.42.e: When the उपसर्ग 'प्र' or 'उप' is attached to the verb 'क्रम्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the meaning expressed is 'the beginning of'.
1.3.42.sa: 'प्र', 'उप' एतौ उपसर्गौ यदा 'प्रारम्भः' अस्मिन् अर्थे प्रयुज्येते, तदा एताभ्याम्  'क्रम्' धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।

1.3.43.v: After the verb क्रम् the आत्मनेपद is optionally used, when it is not preceded by any preposition.
1.3.43.e: When the verb क्रम् is used without any उपसर्ग, it optionally gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
1.3.43.sa: उपसर्गरहितात् 'क्रम्' धातोः विकल्पेन आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।

1.3.44.v: After the verb ज्ञ , when used in the sense of 'denying', the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.45.v: And when used intransitively after the verb ज्ञ , the आत्मनेपद is used, when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

1.3.46.v: After the verb ज्ञ , preceded by सम् and प्रति , the आत्मनेपद is used, when Not Used in the sense of 'remembering with regret'.

1.3.47.v: After the verb वद् , the आत्मनेपद is used, when used in the senses of 'showing brilliance, or proficiency in', pacifying', 'knowledge', 'effort', 'difference of opinion' and 'flattering'.

1.3.48.v: After the verb वद् , the आत्मनेपद is used, when used in the sense of 'speaking articulately in a similar manner'.

1.3.49.v: After the verb वद् , preceded by अनु when it is intransitively used, the आत्मनेपद is used, when the sense is that of 'speaking articulately in a similar manner'.

1.3.50.v: After the verb वद् , the आत्मनेपद is used optionally, when the sense is that of 'contradicting with each other'.

1.3.51.v: After the verb गॄ 'to swallow', when preceded by अव, the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.52.v: After the verb गॄ 'to swallow', when preceded by सम् , the आत्मनेपद affix is used in the sense of 'promising'.

1.3.53.v: After the verb चर् 'to walk' preceded by उत् , when used intransitively, the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.54.v: After the verb चर् 'to walk' preceded by सम् , and when connected with a noun in the Instrumental - 3rd Case, the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.55.v: And after the verb दा 'to give', preceded by सम् , and connected with a noun in the Instrumental - 3rd Case, the आत्मनेपद affix is used, provided this Instrumental Case has the sense of the Dative - 4th Case.

1.3.56.v: After the verb यम् 'to give', preceded by उप , when used in the sense of 'espousing', the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.57.v: After the Desideratives formed by the affix सन् , of the verbs ज्ञा 'to know', श्रु 'to hear', स्मृ 'to remember' and दृश् 'to see', the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.58.v: After the Desiderative of ज्ञा 'to know' when preceded by अनु , the आत्मनेपद affix is Not used.

1.3.59.v: After the Desideratives of श्रु 'to hear', when preceded by प्रत and आङ् , the आत्मनेपद affix is Not used.

1.3.60.v: After the verb शद् 'to decay', when it has one of the affixes with an indicatory श् (शित्) the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.61.v: After the verb मृ 'to die', when it has one of the affixes having an indicatory श् , as well as when it takes the affixes लुङ् (Aorist [[3.2.110]]) and लिङ् (Benedictive [[3.3.159]]), the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.62.v: The verb which is आत्मनेपदि in its primitive form before taking of the affix सन् , will also be आत्मनेपदि when it ends in the affix सन्। in other words; after a Desiderative verb, आत्मनेपद is used, if it would have been used after the primitive verb.

1.3.63.v: Like the verb that takes the affix आम् , if the verb be conjugated with the आत्मनेपद terminations, so of the verb कृ when subjoined thereto as an auxiliary, the terminations are of the आत्मनेपद , even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.
1.3.63.e: When the verb root कृ is used after the आम् प्रत्यय, the verb root कृ gets the same पद as the original verb to which the आम् प्रत्यय has been attached.
1.3.63.sa: कृ-धातोः अनुप्रयोगः क्रियते चेत् तस्य पदम्  मूलधातुवत् भवति ।
1.3.63.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.64.v: After the verb युज् 'to join', the आत्मनेपद is used, when it is preceded by प्र and उप except with reference to sacrificial vessels even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

1.3.65.v: After the verb क्षणु 'to sharpen', preceded by सम् , the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.66.v: After the verb भुज् , the आत्मनेपद is used, except in the sense of protecting.

1.3.67.v: After a verb ending in the affix णि (causal) the आत्मनेपद is used, provided that when the object in the non-णि or non-causal sense becomes the agent in the causal; and when it does not mean 'to remember with regret', even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

1.3.68.v: After the causatives of the verbs भी 'to fear' and स्मि 'to wonder' even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent the आत्मनेपद is employed, when the fear is produced directly by the causative agent.

1.3.69.v: After the causatives of the verbs गृध 'to covet' and वञ्च 'to go' the आत्मनेपद is used in the sense of 'deceiving' even though the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

1.3.70.v: After the causative of the verb लि 'to melt or stick', the आत्मनेपद is employed, when used in the sense of showing respect, subduing and deceiving, even though the fruit of action does not accrue to the agent.

1.3.71.v: After the causative of the verb कृ , the आत्मनेपद is used, when it has the word मिथ्या 'incorrect', as an उपपद or dependent word and is used in the sense of 'repeated wrong utterance', even when the fruit of action does not accrue no the agent.

1.3.72.v: After the verb marked with a स्वरित or which has an indicatory ञित् , the terminations of the आत्मनेपद are used, when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.
1.3.72.e: A verb that contains इत्संज्ञक ञकार or an इत्संज्ञक स्वरित स्वरः gets the प्रत्यया of आत्मनेपद when the doer of the action does the action for himself.
1.3.72.sa: यस्मिन् धातौ ञकारः इत्संज्ञकः अस्ति उत स्वरितः स्वरः इत्संज्ञकः अस्ति, तस्मात् परः कर्त्रभिप्राये क्रियाफले आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.72.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.73.v: After the verb वद् 'to tell', preceded by अप , when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent, the terminations are of the आत्मनेपद।

1.3.74.v: After a verb ending in the affix णि (causal) when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent, the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.75.v: After the verb यम् 'to strive', preceded by सम् , उत् and आङ् , when it does not refer to a book, the आत्मनेपद is used, when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

1.3.76.v: After the verb ज्ञा , when not preceded by any उपसर्ग , the terminations are of the आत्मनेपद , when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

1.3.77.v: The आत्मनेपद is optionally used, when the fact of the fruit of the action accruing to the agent is indicted by an उपपदग i.e. by a word used along with the verb.

1.3.78.v: After the rest i.e. all those verbs not falling under any one of the previous provisions, the terminations of the परस्मैपद are used, in marking the agent i.e. in the active voice.
1.3.78.e: The verbs that do not get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद will get the प्रत्ययाः of परस्मैपद.
1.3.78.sa: यस्मात् धातोः आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययाः न विहिताः सन्ति, तेभ्यः परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्ययाः भवन्ति ।
1.3.78.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

1.3.79.v: After the verb कृ 'to make' preceded by the अनु and पर , परस्मैपद is used, even the fruit of the action goes to the agent and when the sense is that of 'divulging' etc.

1.3.80.v: After the verb क्षिप् 'to throw', coming after अभि , प्रति and अति , परस्मैपद is used, even though the fruit of the action goes to the agent

1.3.81.v: After the verb वह् 'to bear', coming after प्र , परस्मैपद is used, even though the fruit of the action accrues to the the agent.

1.3.82.v: After the verb मृष् 'to bear', preceded by परि , परस्मैपद is used when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

1.3.83.v: After the verb रम् 'to sport', preceded by वि and आङ् , परस्मैपद is used.

1.3.84.v: And also after उप , the verb रम् takes the affixes of the परस्मैपद।

1.3.85.v: After the verb रम् 'to sport', preceded by उप , परस्मैपद is optionally used, when employed intransitively.

1.3.86.v: After the verbs बुध् 'to know', युध् 'to fight', नश् 'to destroy', जन 'to be born', एङ् 'to go', प्रु 'to move', द्रु 'to run' and स्रु 'to flow', ending in the affix णे (i.e. when used in the causative), परस्मैपद is used, even when the fruit of the action goes to the agent.

1.3.87.v: And after the causatives of verbs which have no sense of the 'eating or swallowing' and 'shaking or moving' परस्मैपद is used, even when the fruit of the action goes to the agent.

1.3.88.v: The affixes of the परस्मैपद are used after the causal of that verb, which in its non-causal state was intransitive and had a being endowed with reason for its agent, even when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

1.3.89.v: But the affixes of the परस्मैपद are not used after the causals of the verbs पा 'to drink', दम् 'to tame', आयम् 'to extend', आयस् 'to exert oneself', परिमुह 'to be bewildered', रुच् 'to shine' नृत् 'to dance', वद् 'to speak' and वस् 'to dwell'.

1.3.90.v: The affixes of the परस्मैपद are used optionally after the denominative verbs ending in the affix क्यष।

1.3.91.v: After the verbs द्युत् 'to shine' etc., the terminations of the परस्मैपद are optionally employed, when the affixes of लुण् (Aorist) follow.

1.3.92.v: After the verbs वृत् 'to exist' etc., परस्मैपद is optionally used when the affixes स्य (Future and conditional) and सन् (Desiderative) follow.

1.3.93.v: After the verb क्लिप् 'to be fit', परस्मैपद is optionally used, when लुट् (1st Future) is affixed, as well as when स्य and सन् are affixed.
